hardware.candidate_role: USB/display signer overlong serial drain firmware smoke
hardware.tested_state: firmware with host-tested overlong serial input drain flashed and smoked

procedure: Added a host-buildable T-Display S3 serial-input helper that emits one overlong-frame event and drains the rejected line until newline before accepting subsequent frames.
Updated idf-smoke-capabilities so the shared overlong serial-frame vector is terminated with a newline, allowing the firmware to leave drain state before later serial exchanges.
Ran nSealr/esp32 make ci with 51 Python tests, host-core tests, compileall, and firmware validation.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Built clean ESP32 app version 628bd7f; binary size was 0x8e850 with 0x717b0 bytes free in the app partition.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified image hashes.
Ran make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-smoke-review-scenarios after the malformed/overlong transport smoke to verify the serial reader accepted fresh review requests.
expected_result: The attached board rejects malformed serial transport deterministically, drains overlong input before accepting later serial frames, keeps valid sign_event responses at signing_disabled, and keeps review-scenario smoke working after the overlong transport smoke.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built and flashed app version 628bd7f on the LILYGO T-Display S3 at /dev/cu.usbmodem1101. The capability smoke passed with 38 USB serial exchanges: 8 response frames and 30 expected rejection frames, including malformed_frame or overlong_frame for malformed transport vectors and signing_disabled for valid sign_event. The follow-up review-scenario smoke passed with 7 scenarios, 8 verified exchanges, 7 response frames, and 1 expected unsupported_request rejection, proving fresh review requests worked after overlong-drain handling.
limitations: This is protocol smoke and host-tested serial-reader behavior, not a new manual visual display inspection.

The run does not validate production trusted-display acceptance, production physical-control acceptance, key provisioning, storage, secure boot, flash encryption, debug lock, companion signed-output verification, or real signing.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until every production signing gate is satisfied.
